intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Turing Hall, TA office hours. Everything on the desk is color-coded. The TA doesn't look up.

hello.speaker: javascript
hello.text: Good afternoon. I'm Jay, the TA for Intro to Programming. I've declared a variable for you. Its type is string.

teach.speaker: javascript
teach.text: Your task is to print it. Exactly. Please don't add anything I didn't ask for.

passed.speaker: javascript
passed.text: Correct, and on the first pass. ...That was well done, {player}.

failed.speaker: javascript
failed.text: That output doesn't match the specification. Again, please.

bye.speaker: javascript
bye.text: Office hours end at five. Sharp.
